method.latency_cohort: measurement-window Message cohort with a claim in the closed collection
method.noisy_censoring: unclaimed noisy arrivals absent; never treat selected tail as all 300 arrivals
method.T0: Message.created_at, not an exact ingestion commit timestamp
method.T1: final Message.available_at, after any preclaim extensions
method.gate: original 60 healthy Messages including 20 immediate safety; threshold 10 seconds
method.service_cohort: baseline ordinary works whose claim-return marker falls in the 300 s measurement window; completion may be in drain
method.service_proxy: finalize_end minus claim_commit journal return markers; not exact DB slot occupancy
method.service_rates: inverse mean observed service proxy, not achieved throughput or a stochastic queue fit
method.log_timestamps: not used; log fields used only to map work IDs to fixture organization rank
method.postfix_service_limitation: closed collection has aggregate durable service only; no per-org exact service reconstructed

exact_extension.initial_deadline_limitation: not retained; first eligible observation proves readiness before later ingestion
